articles.headline: Gold Slips as Investors Weigh Fed Rate Outlook
articles.brief: Gold prices moved lower on Monday as investors carefully evaluated the upcoming Federal Reserve interest rate trajectory and macroeconomic data.

articles.headline: Asian Shares Tumble and Oil Rises Ahead of AI Results
articles.brief: Stock markets across Asia saw sharp declines while crude oil prices climbed as investors held their breath for major upcoming artificial intelligence sector earnings reports.

articles.headline: New Zealand Expands Trade Talks as India Pact Starts
articles.brief: New Zealand has initiated dialogue with Brazil and Canada regarding expanding trade partnerships just as its landmark trade pact with India officially goes into effect.

articles.headline: National Australia Bank to Cut 2,500 Jobs in Overhaul
articles.brief: National Australia Bank announced plans to slash 2,500 positions as part of a sweeping cost overhaul strategy triggered by a noticeable slowdown in domestic credit growth.

articles.headline: Social Unrest and Protests Set European Streets Ablaze
articles.brief: Severe social unrest and intense protests have gripped several European nations, including France and Italy, leading to mass arrests, vandalism, and overnight curfews in major urban centers.

articles.headline: Trump Announces $8 Billion Support Program for US Farmers
articles.brief: The United States plans to launch an $8 billion financial support program administered through the Farm Service Agency to offset surging diesel costs for American farmers.

articles.headline: Marco Rubio Begins Three-Day Official Visit to India
articles.brief: US diplomat Marco Rubio has commenced a three-day visit to India, emphasizing strong bilateral alliances while noting that India's ongoing Russian energy imports require mutual understanding.

articles.headline: Gold Mine Collapse in Colombia Kills at Least 14
articles.brief: A tragic collapse at an open-pit gold mine in a remote area of Colombia's Nariño province has left at least 14 miners dead and several others injured.

articles.headline: Deepthi Jeevanji Wins Women's 400m Gold at Asian Para Games
articles.brief: Indian athlete Deepthi Jeevanji secured the gold medal in the women's 400m T20 event while setting a new Asian Para Games record with a time of 56.36 seconds in Nagoya.

articles.headline: Japan Launches Ambitious Spacecraft Mission to Mars Moons
articles.brief: The Japanese space agency has successfully launched a bold exploratory spacecraft toward the mysterious moons of Mars with the primary objective of retrieving soil samples.

articles.headline: Judge Orders Strict Environmental Review for California AI Data Center
articles.brief: A California court has mandated a comprehensive environmental review for a major AI data center proposal in Imperial County following intense pushback from local residents regarding water and emissions.

articles.headline: IRCTC Partners with Quality Council for Train Food Audits
articles.brief: The Indian Railway Catering and Tourism Corporation has partnered with the Quality Council of India to introduce mandatory geo-tagged surprise food safety inspections across trains and stations.
